name: Lukousaurus
isnote: Described as a possible dinosaur by Young (1940); English Wikipedia calls it an archosauromorph and PBDB treats it as a crocodylomorph; placed in Crocodylomorpha as in PBDB.
sum: Lukousaurus is a small archosauromorph known from a snout with distinctive lacrimal horns from the Early Jurassic lower Lufeng Formation, China.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Most of a small snout from the lower Lufeng Formation, Yunnan.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young 1940
